title: Stand up external durable snapshot storage before any more capturing
what_it_improves: Every capture in the repo currently lives inside the static site's own repository, so a schema change, a force-push or a branch deletion rewrites history. Snapshots cannot be immutable in the same store that serves the site.
decision_date: This is the single highest-leverage item: seven requirements are blocked on it.

title: Decide the price-data policy in writing
evidence_needed: The owner's own rule says decide the policy before any backtest is published. No policy exists, so no backtest with prices may be published.
blocking_gate: a written decision: which hosts may be captured

title: Resolve the depth-order source before building the backup-deficiency feature
what_it_improves: Fourteen requirements sit behind the unresolved depth-order source, including the entire backup-deficiency feature the owner asked for.
evidence_needed: route (a) official depth charts verified club-by-club
blocking_gate: or route (b) official snap counts verified for all 32 clubs

title: Capture official inactive lists and snap counts
what_it_improves: Without inactives, 'Questionable' cannot be calibrated and no designation may become a model feature.
evidence_needed: capture the league's inactives article per game
blocking_gate: or the game centre's inactives block
decision_date: This is the single largest information gap on the board.

title: Publish the removal-of-luck panel on the dashboard
what_it_improves: The bar any skill claim must clear is not shown and the luck share is only an inherited claim.
evidence_needed: re-verify the luck share against the official corpus and build the panel
note: Do not publish any skill claim until the panel shows skill above the luck bar.

title: Pre-register every strategy before its evaluation window
what_it_improves: Zero strategies have a pre-window commit hash, so no strategy can qualify.
blocking_gate: sample window and gates committed before the first kickoff

title: Split the site into a public analysis layer and a private data layer
what_it_improves: Raw row-level data is not separated from derived analysis until the terms are read.
evidence_needed: public site holding derived analysis only; raw rows in a private store
note: Do not publish raw row-level data until the terms are read.

title: Add durable snapshot storage and alerts
what_it_improves: Captures are not immutable and there is no freshness monitor or alert on source/schema changes.
decision_date: Monitor freshness and alert on source/schema changes.

title: Add control baselines (random; favorites only) to every leaderboard run
what_it_improves: Skill cannot be separated from luck without a baseline.
evidence_needed: baselines reported beside every strategy row

title: Keep parlays and prop combos behind a joint-evidence gate
what_it_improves: Multiplying marginal probabilities is invalid under dependence.
evidence_needed: a directly validated joint probability plus the operator's void/push rules
note: A combo may only be ranked when both a validated joint probability and void/push rules exist.

title: Add a per-team view: starters out
Add an announced-starter evidence field (not an inferred replacement)
what_it_improves: Replacements are blank where unannounced; inferred replacements must not be presented as fact.
evidence_needed: dated starter changes cited; replacements blank where unannounced
note: The blank replacement columns are correct for the report page.

title: Calibrate ""Questionable"" empirically instead of using old percentages
what_it_improves: Official text gives no percentages and designation play rates are unmeasured.
evidence_needed: join several seasons of designations to official inactives and measure play rate per designation with confidence intervals
note: Only then decide whether the label becomes a model feature.

title: Build the interactive Offense vs. Defense Matchup Deficiency Matrix (1st-4th String)
what_it_improves: No screen surfaces trench and coverage mismatches.
evidence_needed: one screen showing starter vs replacement mismatch for WR1 vs CB2/3

title: Treat the injury report as a timestamped series
evidence_needed: A single weekly snapshot cannot show Questionable->Out changes or practice trends (DNP->LP->FP).
blocking_gate: daily captures Wednesday to kickoff with fetch timestamps
